answer: By the karst of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, released only after three unrelated confirmations, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. A tide of per-task receipts records who did what, and the jade of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
